experiment_data.hypothesis: D019: RSA (Representational Similarity Analysis) on LIBERO-Goal features. Tests whether VLA training improves action-relevant representational structure, not just instruction presence. Same-scene/different-goal pairs: representation dissimilarity vs action dissimilarity correlation. G1: trained RSA peak > untrained peak + 0.05. G2: trained > untrained in ≥ 5/33 layers.
